body:
Geranamine, Select Reports
DR. GONZO
1.2g Theanine
Wait 30 min
1 pill + 1 vodka/rocks (belvedere of course)
Wait 10 min
2 pills + 1 vodka
Wait 10 min
1 pills
Very good combo. There's somthing to it for sure, I just need to tweak the dosages around a little bit, and also try it after a few days cleansing with no pills. There were certainly transient low-grade euphoric rolling feelings even with the first pill/drink. Much more intermittent than MDMA, however, and much less poignant. I almost feel like the Theanine + Alcohol combo was a pretty significant euphoric in itself, I'll try it again next weekend without adding the pills until well after the first drink.
I would also like to try it on a completely empty stomach, I had a 800kcal shake about 1hr before...which among other things had 12g Lecithin in it, yeilding quite a bit of phosphatidylcholine, which may have had some interaction as well.
I've experimented a bit and here's what I've found:
Geranamine+MDMA = lessening of the MDMA effect, better without geranamine
Geranamine+Ketamine = huge increase in the effectiveness of the Ketamine, almost too much. Like the scene in Fear and Loathing when they're walking through the turnstyle into the carnival with no motor control trying to pay the man...
_________________
EXITSCRACTH7
Geranamine worked quite well with DXM, as well; although I question the safety of the combination.
_________________
DJREMIX
Took an dose before a pool party. And then had a nice little b-day surprise. One line hit sooo damn hard and loooooong it almost made me freak out, cause I couldnt understand why it did that. Until the LSA kicked in and I forgot about it and got mesmerised by the walls .
